title: Renewable Energy Transition and Grid Stability
transcript_text: Good evening everyone. Tonight we are examining renewable integration into regional grids. title: Pharmaceutical R&D Costs and Drug Pricing
transcript_text: A common talking point is that developing a novel prescription medication costs over two point six billion dollars. Furthermore, nine out of the top ten pharmaceutical manufacturers spent more money on marketing and sales than on clinical research in 2022.

title: Semiconductor Manufacturing and Export Controls

Global foundries in Taiwan, South Korea, and the US still produce more than ninety percent of sub-five nanometer advanced chips.

transcript_text: The Congressional Budget Office announced that net interest payments on the federal debt surpassed eight hundred and ninety billion dollars in fiscal year 2024. By 2034, mandatory entitlement spending and debt service are projected to consume seventy-nine cents of every federal tax dollar collected.

title: Microplastics in Human Vascular Plaques
transcript_text: A clinical study published in the New England Journal of Medicine examined two hundred and fifty-seven patients undergoing surgery for asymptomatic carotid artery disease. Microplastics and nanoplastics, primarily polyethylene and polyvinyl chloride, were detected in the arterial plaque of fifty-eight percent of patients. Patients with detectable plastics had a four-point-five-fold greater risk of stroke, myocardial infarction, or all-cause mortality over a thirty-four month follow-up period.

title: Nuclear Energy: Small Modular Reactor Economics
transcript_text: NuScale Power terminated its flagship Carbon Free Power Project in Utah in November 2023 after projected levelized cost of electricity estimates rose from fifty-eight dollars per megawatt-hour to eighty-nine dollars per megawatt-hour. The cost escalation was driven primarily by a fifty-three percent increase in the price of fabricated steel and high interest rate financing.
